description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for the Book entity in the book project. It includes various properties related to a book such as title, pages, genre, format, author, and other metadata. The class uses Lombok for boilerplate code reduction and Jackson annotations for JSON serialization.

classes.name: BookDto
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class representing a book with properties such as title, pages, genre, author, and review information.

methods.name: getters/setters generated by Lombok
methods.description: Automatically generated getter and setter methods for all private fields due to Lombok's @Data annotation.
